description: This file implements the MediaPipelineCapabilities class and related factory functions for media pipeline capabilities, including creation, destruction, and querying supported MIME types and support status for specific MIME types.

classes.name: MediaPipelineCapabilities
classes.description: Implements media pipeline capabilities, including querying supported MIME types and MIME type support status.

methods.name: getSupportedMimeTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of supported MIME types for a given media source type.

methods.name: isMimeTypeSupported
methods.description: Checks if a specific MIME type is supported.
